ghi_chu: Doc toan van day du (29408 ky tu, den Dieu 11), khong tim thay bat ky trich dan nao ve 10/2009/TT-BGTVT ngoai phan ly do model. Khong co dieu khoan bai bo/thay the.
Doc toan van (33340 ky tu, den Dieu 15), khong tim thay trich dan 10/2017/TT-BKHCN trong than van ban.
Doc toan van (71836 ky tu, den Dieu 13), khong tim thay trich dan 66/2009/NĐ-CP trong than van ban.
Khong tim thay trich dan 38/2009/TT-BNNPTNT trong toan van nguon (25656 ky tu).
Chi co trong phan ly do model tu dua ra, khong co trich dan trong than van ban nguon.
Khong tim thay trich dan trong than van ban, chi co trong ly do model.

Tim thay trich dan that: [Dieu 12 > Khoan 2 > Diem a] liet ke ro 'Quy dinh ve thoi viec doi voi cong chuc tai Nghi dinh so 54/2005/NĐ-CP ngay 19/4/2005...' - dang cau truc liet ke trong dieu khoan bai bo/thay the, cho thay co can cu that. Loai truoc (ThayThe) hoac gan voi BaiBoTungPhan co kha nang dung hon KhongLienQuan.

Dieu 24 nguon co nhac 50/2018/TT-NHNN trong dieu khoan chuyen tiep (ho so cu), nhung khong doc duoc toan van Dieu 24 de xac dinh chac chan day la bang chung ung ho hay phan doi quan he thay the — dang mo ho theo pattern da biet (dieu khoan chuyen tiep hay bi hieu nham).

Tim thay trich dan that o dong 1382 ('Thong tu so 53/2015/TT-BTC ngay 21/4/2015...') trong than van ban nguon, cho thay co nhac truc tiep dich nay trong dieu khoan lien quan. Loai truoc (ThayThe) nhieu kha nang dung hon KhongLienQuan.

Toan van co nhieu lan nhac '58/2012/NĐ-CP' nhung deu la DAN CHIEU DEN QUY DINH VAN CON HIEU LUC cua 58/2012 (vd 'theo quy dinh tai khoan 1,2 Dieu 71 Nghi dinh 58/2012/NĐ-CP') - day la bang chung 58/2012 VAN CON HIEU LUC va duoc dan chieu song song, khong phai bi thay the. Ung ho KhongLienQuan.
Khong tim thay trich dan trong than van ban nguon.
Khong co trich dan than van ban; ly do cua ca 2 model deu chi ra van de cap bac (Thong tu khong the bai bo Nghi dinh) ung ho KhongLienQuan.
Khong co trich dan than van ban, ly do Gemini hop ly (khong co dieu khoan bai bo cu the).

Tim thay bang chung RO RANG: [Dieu 2 > Khoan 1] 'Bai bo Thong tu so 09/2015/TT-BYT, tru cac noi dung sau:' - tuyen bo bai bo truc tiep, khop voi 'tru' (loai truoc BaiBoTungPhan). Revoke thanh KhongLienQuan la SAI ro rang.
Khong tim thay trich dan trong than van ban.
Khong tim thay chuoi so hieu trong than van ban (Gemini tu ghi nhan Dieu 48 chi la dan chieu chung, khong phai bai bo).
Khong tim thay trich dan trong than van ban.

Khong tim thay trich dan trong than van ban, ca 2 model deu khong tim duoc dieu khoan cu the.

Giong ca truoc (cung nguon 86-2016-NĐ-CP) - chi la dan chieu quy dinh con hieu luc cua 58/2012/NĐ-CP, khong phai thay the.

Tim thay bang chung RO RANG: [Dieu 16 > Khoan 2] 'Nghi dinh so 302/HĐBT ngay 19/8/1992... ve quyen, trach nhiem cua cong doan co so... het hieu luc ke tu ngay Nghi dinh nay co hieu luc.' - tuyen bo het hieu luc truc tiep, khop voi loai truoc (ThayThe). Revoke la SAI.

Tim thay bang chung RO RANG: [Dieu 9 > Khoan 1] '...thay the Thong tu so 56/2009/TT-BTC..., Thong tu so 159/2009/TT-BTC ngay 06/8/2009... ve viec sua doi, bo sung Thong tu so 56/2009/TT-BTC...' - liet ke ro rang 159/2009/TT-BTC trong danh sach bi thay the. Khop loai truoc (ThayThe). Revoke la SAI.
Ly do Gemini chi ra 97/CP thuc te da bi thay the boi 1 nghi dinh KHAC (178/1999/NĐ-CP), khong phai boi nguon nay (84/1998/NĐ-CP). Ung ho KhongLienQuan cho CHINH cap nay.

Trich dan tim duoc cho thay nguon sua doi 83/2013/NĐ-CP (da duoc 91/2014/NĐ-CP sua doi truoc do) chu khong phai sua doi truc tiep 91/2014/NĐ-CP. Ung ho KhongLienQuan, tuy con it nhieu mo ho ve chuoi sua doi.
Khong tim thay trich dan trong than van ban, 2 van ban khac linh vuc theo ly do Gemini.

Tim thay bang chung RO RANG: [Dieu 9 > Khoan 2] 'Thong tu nay bai bo Thong tu so 24/2014/TT-BCT...' - tuyen bo bai bo truc tiep. Loai dung la BaiBoToanBo (khong hoan toan khop loai truoc ThayThe nhung chac chan KHONG phai KhongLienQuan). Revoke la SAI.
